variants.specifics: Brackenford: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Wenna
offer.text:
Greetings, brave Wanderer! Please, help me, a dreadful thing has happened at my mill!

Not long ago, a band of Urchins crept in through the yard. They stole my amulet and ran off to their barrow! I could ward them off if I only had it, but they took it east of the ford. I'm afraid they'll be back to wreck the mill if I go out after it!

Will you fetch it back for me? I will give a good reward for its quick return.

completion.speaker: Wenna
completion.text: Oh, thank you kindly, Wanderer! I could never pay you in full for this... But please, take this as a token of my appreciation!

journal.text: Retrieve Wenna's amulet from the Urchins' barrow.

guard.speaker: Garrick
guard.text: Step back from that gate, lad! Unless you WANT to get robbed!

shop.speaker: Dunstan
shop.text: Well... Maybe not the newest exactly... But solid all the same!

townsfolk2.speaker: Townsman
townsfolk2.text: We will hold the ford, but you must see Halvard in the Moot Hall. Thanks for your help, brave Adventurer!

variants.specifics: Skarn Delve: cross-section: bounty_offer, the magic, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Paymaster Orrin
offer.text:
Hello, young sir. I surmise you have come about the bounty.

There is a generous reward on Skrit the Imp King -- dead or alive. He and his noisy swarm of Imps have been raiding the ore carts for weeks.

Take care, you do not want to get bitten by those spiteful pests.

completion.speaker: Paymaster Orrin
completion.text:
Ho, there! Nib complained of squeaking down this tunnel, so I came to look.

You have single handedly slain the dreaded Skrit! Very impressive! My profound respect is yours! Skrit's swarm has plagued Skarn Delve for weeks! I'll take it from here. We will all rest easier now that this vile pest is dead!

And here is your reward -- 100 in gold!

guard.speaker: Hurk
guard.text: Hold it right there, stranger! Nib says you hit him with a pick for no reason and his bruises prove it! Let's go. There's a cold and tidy cell waiting for you! Will you come quietly, stranger?

townsfolk1.speaker: Tarn
townsfolk1.text: You can find Mobb the Tallyman in the Counting House. He has the Lift Key.

townsfolk2.speaker: Garn
townsfolk2.text: We have held the Counting House! Now we must drive the Trolls out of all of Skarn Delve!

variants.specifics: Gorrow: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the inn, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Pellan
offer.text:
Welcome to Gorrow, noble Adventurer! We've been expecting you!

The Mud Imps who live below the walks have gone wild! They crept up the posts and stole my Amulet! A Hunter chased the little brutes into the sinkhole, but hasn't come back.

Will you go into the sinkhole to the South and recover my Amulet from the Imps? Come see me once you are back. I'll be home on the big platform.

completion.speaker: Pellan
completion.text:
My Amulet! Thank you, kind sir! All Gorrow is truly thankful for your fine work.

Here, take this as a small gift from the hamlet. The Captain is waiting at the landing. You should visit the shops first, then go and talk to him at once.

journal.text: Recover Mayor Pellan's amulet from the Mud Imps.

guard.speaker: Thoss
guard.text: Onto the boards, stranger! Enjoy your stay!

shop.speaker: Bidda
shop.text: You look like you could use a bed, friend.

townsfolk1.speaker: Yarrin
townsfolk1.text: Help! The leeches are in my bed!

townsfolk2.speaker: Tuk
townsfolk2.text: Blaaargh! Get this thing off my leg!

variants.specifics: Karth Vael: cross-section: bounty_offer, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Ostrag
offer.text:
Blast! Where were you, lad!? The Trolls stormed the Granary Yard and we'd have lost the winter stores to them if Dorrik's pikemen had not charged in at the last moment!

But in the confusion, their chief Grolm got away with a dozen of our war-horses, leaving the burnt stores our smallest worry! All of Karth Vael is now at risk if Grolm lives!

You must follow his trail, northeast to the Troll Den on Mount Dreg! Kill Grolm or we are doomed!

completion.speaker: Ostrag
completion.text:
In calmer times, the barracks of Karth Vael would ring with cheers for the death of Grolm! Well done! But now we must stop the Troll King Skorn once and for all.

Please accept these with our deepest thanks for your fine work!

journal.text: Go to the Troll Den and kill Grolm.

guard.speaker: Hulm
guard.text: Hey, you ought to get a proper cloak.

shop.speaker: Zibbet
shop.text: You'd better be quick the garrison's buying up all my steel.

townsfolk1.speaker: Nessa
townsfolk1.text: Hello again. Has the Troll King been stopped, yet?

townsfolk2.speaker: Tam
townsfolk2.text: I've been told to keep away from newcomers.

variants.specifics: Orlmere: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the magic, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Dorrel
offer.text:
Skerrik has been working on a Cloak of Tides for me for some time. He should have been done with it and had it brought to me by now.

Take the old pier out to Skerrik's hut on Eel Island and find the Cloak. Will you go?

completion.speaker: Dorrel
completion.text:
You found the Cloak of Tides! Wonderful!

My worst fears for Skerrik, however, have come true. I'll miss him, but there is no time for grief. Orlmere needs me and Rudge wants a word with you. Take this Blue Potion for your trouble.

Good luck, brave Adventurer!

journal.text: Retrieve the Cloak of Tides which Skerrik has made.

shop.speaker: Ismene
shop.text: Drifters aren't welcome here. But for a little extra, I'll sell to you anyway.

townsfolk2.speaker: Crodd
townsfolk2.text: Can't swim? Not so clever, eh?

variants.specifics: Zorreth: cross-section: bounty_offer, the inn, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Tessik
offer.text:
Why are you so late!? We are in terrible trouble!

Vicious giant bats and Imps from the pit have overrun the vaults beneath the Archive. Several clerks have been lost protecting the college's precious books!

Please, we implore you! Drive the beasts from the vaults, rescue my clerks and I will pay you generously.

This key opens the gate to the first trapped clerk. He will lead you to the others.

I also have a spell book which ought to be very handy.

completion.speaker: Tessik
completion.text:
You are truly a hero! My sincere thanks.

As you were saving my clerks down below, the Captain stopped by, asking after you. He's waiting at the Lower Gate -- south of here.

Before you leave, here is some gold for your trouble.

journal.text: Slay or banish all the beasts in the vaults. Rescue the 4 trapped clerks.

guard.speaker: Gorvo
guard.text: We don't see many travelers at the gate these days.

shop.speaker: Pippet
shop.text: Dark days, lad. I can't believe Maldrek turned on the college. Dire news indeed! Better rest up while you can!

townsfolk1.speaker: Fenn
townsfolk1.text: Maldrek must have found some way past our wards. At noon the Observatory was quiet, by dusk it was swarming with Gargoyles and Imps! They want the Orrery.

townsfolk2.speaker: Hendry
townsfolk2.text: Shouldn't you be out chasing Gargoyles?

variants.specifics: Kell Varn: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Mylka
offer.text:
Wretched little fiends! The Imps have crept into my cellar and made a mess of everything already!

I am Mylka. I am looking for my Amulet of Warmth. I fear it has been carried off to a nearby Imp Nest.

If you could get it back from them, I would be willing to teach you a spell or two. Will you search the wretched Imp Nest for it?

completion.speaker: Mylka
completion.text:
My Amulet of Warmth! I feared it was lost for good.

You are braver than you look. Perhaps you might make a fine student.

Follow me to the counter. Please take this Blue Potion with my thanks. We have much to discuss when you return from your quest.

journal.text: Recover Mylka's Amulet of Warmth from the Imp Nest.

guard.speaker: Brek
guard.text: Warden Odrin is waiting in the Long Hall. He has the key to the Pass Gate.

shop.speaker: Dagg
shop.text:
Wanna see a new blade?

I call it 'Ogre's Lullaby.'

townsfolk1.speaker: Hobb
townsfolk1.text: Kell Varn will never fall to the Ogres. Stand firm for the honor of Warden Odrin!

townsfolk2.speaker: Ketra
townsfolk2.text: A spy from the Hold just ran past me! Be fast! He's heading for the gate!

variants.specifics: Ashkar: cross-section: bounty_offer, the magic, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Gorm
offer.text:
Sorry, mate, the ore lift is jammed! Only way down to the lower forge is the old cart tunnel, through the Goblin warren. But, if you go that way, mate, keep your guard up! The Goblins stole my best helmet while I was napping!

If you bring it back, I'll give you a damn fine spell book.

completion.speaker: Gorm
completion.text: My helmet! I had given it up for lost! I'm eternally grateful. Here's the book, as promised.

journal.text: Find the helmet stolen from Gorm by the Goblins and bring it back to him.

guard.speaker: Tobb
guard.text: Stranger! Ugh! I've heard what the Trolls do to travelers on the road! Turn back!

shop.speaker: Ilsa
shop.text: Sorry friend, you've bought me dry! I've no potions left to give you.

townsfolk1.speaker: Fenn
townsfolk1.text: Ew! I watched that huge lava slug ooze right under Maldrek's door!

townsfolk2.speaker: Odo
townsfolk2.text: Did you see where the ore cart went? It couldn't have just rolled away!

variants.specifics: Tolmar Cross: cross-section: heirloom_fetch, the inn, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Hessel
offer.text:
Why did you take so long!? We have a terrible problem!

Hideous overgrown crows and flying imps from the Hollow have overrun the stable loft. Two of my stablehands were hurt in defense of the inn's good name!

Please, I beg you! Will you drive off the beasts and fetch back my Cloak of Warding? I'll pay you handsomely.

This key will open the loft door.

I also have a potion that might come in handy.

completion.speaker: Hessel
completion.text:
You are a true champion! My deepest thanks.

While you were up in the loft, fighting those crows, Orsk came by, looking for you. He's waiting for you at the Warden's Post -- north of here.

Take this gold and potion for your trouble, before you go.

journal.text: Kill the crows and imps in Hessel's stable loft. Recover the Cloak of Warding.

guard.speaker: Gurm
guard.text: Keep your chin up, stranger, the Trolls will break on our spears!

shop.speaker: Pegg
shop.text: Maybe you'd like a hot meal or a room?

townsfolk1.speaker: Lorna
townsfolk1.text: Hello stranger! Look me up when you're done with the Trolls.

townsfolk2.speaker: Dray
townsfolk2.text: Get that Troll chief and tear his tusks out!

variants.specifics: Tosk: cross-section: bounty_offer, the arms, a guard, two townsfolk

offer.speaker: Tamsin
offer.text:
My luck has been rotten of late. Two weeks ago, Ogres broke into the barn and carried off my horses.

I don't expect I'll see them again, but I'd love to see those brutes run out of the valley.

There's coin for anyone who chases them off.

completion.speaker: Tamsin
completion.text:
So the Ogres have been chased off! Well done, lad! We shall all rest easier knowing those brutes won't be stomping through our barley!

Now take your reward... 90 in gold! You're always welcome at Tamsin's!

journal.text: Drive off the Ogres that raided Tamsin's barn.

guard.speaker: Fenn
guard.text: Hide, stranger, hide! Hah, hah, hah...!

shop.speaker: Grint
shop.text: Wanna buy a scythe? They're salvaged from the vast scrap heaps of Ulm Gorra.

townsfolk1.speaker: Dobb
townsfolk1.text: They say you're the one who chased those pesky boars off our fields! Thank you, kind sir!

townsfolk2.speaker: Tamsin
townsfolk2.text: Hey! Get out of my barn!
